faq.question: What is Legend Mod?
faq.answer: Legend Mod is a browser client and Chrome extension that adds custom skins, themes, configurable controls, multiboxing, replays, and many other features to Agar.io-style cell games. It is not a game itself.

faq.question: Is Legend Mod the same as Agar.io?
faq.answer: No. Legend Mod is a separate extension/client project. Agar.io is a game by Miniclip. Expanding Land is a separate independent game. These are three distinct entities.

faq.question: Is Expanding Land the official Agar.io service?
faq.answer: No. Expanding Land is an independent multiplayer cell game built from scratch in C. It is not affiliated with Agar.io or Miniclip.

faq.question: Does the Expanding Land map change?
faq.answer: Yes. The server controls expansion and contraction of the circular arena. The map scale ranges from 0.25x to 8x based on player activity.

faq.question: Are all opponents in Expanding Land human?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Human and server-controlled bot counts vary by arena. In-game counters distinguish the populations.

faq.question: What is the maximum player count?
faq.answer: Expanding Land supports up to 3,840 concurrent real players per arena. Actual counts depend on server configuration.

faq.question: How do I install Legend Mod?
faq.answer: Install the Legend Express Chrome extension from the Chrome Web Store, or visit legendmod.ml/play.html to use the web client directly.

faq.question: What languages does Legend Mod support?
faq.answer: 16 languages: Arabic, Bulgarian, German, Greek, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian (beta), Italian (beta), Japanese (beta), Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (beta), Russian, Turkish, and Traditional Chinese.

faq.question: Is Legend Mod free?
faq.answer: Yes. Legend Mod and Expanding Land are free to use with no subscription required.

faq.question: Does Legend Mod collect personal data?
faq.answer: The Chrome extension does NOT collect, store or transmit personal data externally. See the privacy policy at legendmod.ml/privacy.html.

faq.question: What mods are compatible with Expanding Land?
faq.answer: Legend Mod (legendmod.ml), Delta Mod (deltio.pages.dev), and Agar2 (agar2.com) are compatible client mods.

faq.question: How do I spectate in Expanding Land?
faq.answer: Press Escape while alive to enter free spectate. Up to 200+ spectator slots with free-roam camera. Click the minimap to move the camera.

faq.question: What is the Command Centre?
faq.answer: A fuzzy-search palette (Ctrl+K) that lets you search and activate any setting, hotkey, theme option or window in Legend Mod. It supports multi-language queries and can be pinned as a quick bar during gameplay.

faq.question: What is the dynamic map?
faq.answer: Expanding Land's circular arena auto-resizes from 0.25x to 8x based on player count. The server controls expansion and contraction of the boundary.

faq.question: What is a scan trick?
faq.answer: A movement technique where cursor position snaps to fixed directional increments (8-32 directions) for precise cell positioning.

faq.question: What is line split?
faq.answer: A rapid multi-split technique (x8 or x16) in a straight line toward the cursor with configurable timing and lock duration.

faq.question: What is the Practice Arena?
faq.answer: An offline mode with 8 exercise types (free, split, virus, dodge, path, escape, feed, merge) where you practice against bots without connecting to a server. Personal bests and ghost replay of your best run.

faq.question: What is the Theme Workshop?
faq.answer: A tool to create, save (up to 30 themes, 5 versions each), rename, copy and delete custom themes. Live preview with 15-second auto-revert, side-by-side comparison, and a gallery of shipped themes.

faq.question: What are Settings Profiles?
faq.answer: Named sets of all gameplay and visual settings (up to 30 profiles) that can be switched instantly. Auto-switching per server type, game mode or input device. 5 automatic backups.

faq.question: What is the Spectator Director?
faq.answer: An automatic camera system that follows the most interesting action while spectating. Includes watchlist (20 players), map bookmarks (20 positions), cinematic camera, broadcast HUD, and leaderboard history.

faq.question: What are Custom Macros?
faq.answer: 3 macro slots for automated action sequences (split, feed, wait, move) with up to 24 steps each. Dry run mode available. Safety timing limits enforced.

faq.question: What are User Scripts / Plugins?
faq.answer: 5 script slots for custom JavaScript extensions with plugin header format, settings API (up to 20 settings), version compatibility checking, and a catalogue of example plugins.

faq.question: What is the companion second screen?
faq.answer: A feature that broadcasts live game state (minimap, mass, cell positions, chat) to a second browser window or device via BroadcastChannel. Useful for multi-monitor setups or streaming.

faq.question: What is the death recap?
faq.answer: A Game Over card feature showing the last 20 seconds of your life as 3-6 summarised steps with a mass sparkline, plus the killer's name and mass.

faq.question: What is the Danger Zone?
faq.answer: The outer ring during Expanding Land map contraction. Being in it adds +0.01 to the anti-teaming multiplier per cycle, discouraging camping at the edges.

faq.question: How is Expanding Land different from Agar.io?
faq.answer: Expanding Land has a dynamic circular arena (not fixed square), is built from scratch in C (~5ms tick), supports 3,840 players per arena, has 200+ spectator slots, anti-teaming and coordinate scrambling anti-cheat, and is by an independent developer (not Miniclip).
